hero.headline: I make complex data and AI work easy to understand.
hero.intro: Technical writer and editor with a background in journalism, data science, and technical education. I turn analytical and scientific ideas into clear, accurate content for the people who need to use them.

about: I started as a newspaper reporter, became an investigative data editor, and spent six years teaching data skills to thousands of journalists. I now document an enterprise AI platform at Dataiku.
The through-line: I like working next to subject-matter experts, learning how things really work, and explaining them so the reader can act.

experience.title: Senior Technical Writer
experience.summary: Documentation for an enterprise AI and machine learning platform.
bullets: Primary documentation owner for Generative AI features.
Edit docs on machine learning, agents, data processing, and analytics for clarity and accuracy.
Contribute to style guides, terminology governance, and review processes.
Mentor junior writers; build videos, tutorials, and visual workflows.

experience.title: Deputy Executive Director (earlier: Senior Training Director, Training Director)
experience.summary: Led training content and programs for thousands of journalism professionals.
bullets: Personally trained 3,300+ people in data analysis, coding, research methods, and visualization.
Coached reporters and experts on communicating complex findings.
Developed editorial standards, instructional guidelines, and review processes.

experience.title: Director of Training (earlier: Interim Executive Director, Director of Data Services)
experience.summary: Training and data services for nonprofit newsrooms nationwide.
bullets: Ran webinars and an annual training event.
Led the organization as interim executive director.
Delivered data analysis and visualization projects.
